notes.title: Quick Update on Lanesplit
notes.notes:
[u][b]Quick Update on Lanesplit 🛣️[/b][/u]
Hey everyone! 
I just wanted to give a heads-up that there’s a bit of a delay in Lanesplit’s release.
 I have been running into some annoying issues with the multiplayer setup (because, of course, networking never makes things easy ), however, they have now been sorted out and preparation is underway for a playtest sometime in Q2 (hopefully by May!) 
Thanks for your patience while I squash these bugs. More news soon! :)
- FunkyMouse
